description: Create or update a quote by supplying the COMPLETE desired basket. Add/remove/change items in that list and call again. UAE only. For Research Use Only. This research-use-only catalogue is for buyers 21+ years of age and is supplied for research purposes only. Not for human or veterinary use. Includes the selected emirate’s delivery estimate, cutoff and fee explanation. Does not store or submit an order. First use search_products for exact product IDs. Supply country AE, the buyer-selected emirate and the COMPLETE items array of {id, qty}; combine duplicate IDs. Ask the buyer for any missing destination before calling. Do not send prices, totals, consent or approval flags. The example uses Dubai only for illustration: replace it with the buyer-selected emirate and replace PRODUCT_ID_FROM_SEARCH with an orderable id from search. Do not send buyer details to quote_basket. Example arguments: {"country":"AE","emirate":"Dubai","items":[{"id":"PRODUCT_ID_FROM_SEARCH","qty":1}]}

country.description: Required delivery country code: AE means United Arab Emirates.

emirate.description: Required buyer-selected destination. Use an exact listed emirate; ask the buyer if unknown, never assume Dubai.

items.description: The COMPLETE desired basket of 1–20 distinct variant IDs. Combine the same ID into one line; send the entire updated basket on every call.

id.description: Exact id from the latest search_products result, not sku, product name or URL. Select an orderable variant.

qty.description: Quantity as a JSON integer from 1 to 10, for example 2, not "2". The field is qty, not quantity.

promoCode.description: Optional buyer-supplied promotion code, up to 24 letters or digits. Omit when absent; do not invent one.

name: quote_basket
